name: Chat Title
description: Auto-renames a chat as soon as the first reply lands, then again after every N completed assistant turns (default 5), using a side model — and keeps a Core-side history of the names it chose so you can see how a conversation drifted. Enablement, the first-turn rename, frequency, and the model to use are all settings.
tagline: Names your chats for you, automatically

fields.label: Auto-rename chats
fields.description: Generate short titles as the conversation progresses. Off leaves the first-message placeholder.

fields.label: Rename after the first reply
fields.description: Name the chat as soon as its first reply lands, instead of waiting for the Nth turn. Off leaves the first-message placeholder until then.

fields.label: Rename every N turns
fields.description: Re-title after this many completed assistant turns (1 = every turn). Default 5. The first reply is always covered by the setting above.

fields.label: Title model
fields.description: Optional. Empty uses the local engine (or the node default).
